title: 81. Generate Parentheses

examples.explanation: Each string uses 3 pairs of parentheses arranged so that every opening bracket is properly closed before the string ends.
With only one pair, the only valid way to arrange them is "()".
"(())" nests the two pairs, while "()()" places them consecutively.

hints: Build each result from left to right while tracking the counts of open and closed parentheses.
Add an opening parenthesis while fewer than n have been used, and add a closing one only when it cannot make the prefix invalid.
